name: gnomAD structural variants and copy-number variants

version.value: SVs v4.1.0, CNVs v4.1.0 (site header); also SVs v2.1

scope: Genome SV callset (sites VCF, 1.74 GB, 2,154,486 records: 1,206,278 DEL, 356,035 BND, 304,645 INS, 269,326 DUP, 15,189 CPX, 2,193 INV, 721 multi-allelic CNV, 99 CTX; all with SVTYPE and END) and exome CNV callset (8.9 MB VCF; non-neuro and non-neuro-controls subsets). Both are GRCh38.

quantitative.summary: Allele counts and frequencies per ancestry group and SV type; multi-allelic CNV sites (SVTYPE=CNV, 721 records) carry copy-number counts and frequencies (CN_COUNT, CN_FREQ, CN_NUMBER) instead of a single AF.
quantitative.units: counts / frequency in [0, 1]; SVLEN in bp

coverage_limitations: CNV callset is exome-based so non-coding CNVs are missed
For interval overlap only DEL, DUP, INV, CPX, CNV and MCNV records with END > POS are treated as intervals; INS, BND and CTX are points or breakends
Short-read SV sensitivity is limited for repeats and complex events
known_omissions: Long-read SV catalogue (release/lr) was listed but not inspected

reuse_decision.rationale: Both VCFs are fetched and validated: the exome CNV VCF (8.9 MB) and the genome SV sites VCF (1.74 GB; size from the S3 listing, MD5 from the downloads page). They complement the older control-cohort DGV catalogue and the ClinGen dosage regions.

status.notes: S3 listings give exact sizes; both files downloaded, checksum-verified and validated.

mechanism_evidence.note: PREDICTED_LOF, PREDICTED_COPY_GAIN and related gene-overlap annotations

evidence_profile.biological_context: Germline SV calls (genome callset) and CNV calls (exome callset) in the gnomAD cohorts. Algorithm and evidence fields record how each call was made, and PREDICTED_* INFO fields annotate the gene-level consequence of each call.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Population allele counts and frequencies for calls made by combining several algorithms. Sensitivity differs by size and type, and PREDICTED_* consequences are annotation predictions and not assays.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low to moderate. Dosage-type consequences (whole-gene deletion, duplication, exon overlap) follow from gene overlap; effects of breakpoints on regulation, gene fusion and position effects are not assessed.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Frequency in population controls bounds pathogenic claims for dosage-sensitive genes; it does not give a phenotype.
evidence_profile.absence_means: Absence from the callset reflects detectability (size, type, repeat context, coverage) as well as rarity; poorly mappable regions are under-called.
